<div class="card-body">
'''Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm''' is a [[Dark]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン：ラーズ家のモイスチャー・ファーム</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">武器運命数を引く際それぞれに＋１。支配しているなら、フォース消耗に＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-294o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm.

'''Dark Side:''' Add 1 to each weapon destiny drawn. If you control here, add 1 to the Force drain.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese adds 1 to each weapon destiny drawn; English adds 1 to each of your weapon destiny draws here.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (Dark)|Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
